pages.text: Place it within $(num)24$() blocks of the core and feed it RF. Use $(thing)Laser +$() to fire it.

The beam bends around the core and comes back stronger: $(num)1.15x$() at low power, up to $(num)1.30x$() at full power.$(br2)The profit comes out of your mass: $(num)1$() mass per $(num)100,000 RF$() fired. Keep the stabilizers fed.
